name: Oversynth
storyline:
Soooo... A small indie project where you kill robots!
And... I can't really say much... This game was made by me. And the problem is that i might be a mid game developer, but i am not that good of a storyteller. I can't even understand it's genre... Arena Slasher?..
summary: Welcome to OVERSYNTH, AKOD for short. A game about rending robots apart with a sword, which is still in alpha. But there is already an infinite mode, three different testing polygons, 5 different enemies and, of course, EXPLOSIONS!!! And... Well... Ummmm... COOL EXPLOSIONS!!! YAY!
